description: Test utility implementation for HTTP/2 frame decoder listener, including failing and logging listener classes.

classes.name: FailingHttp2FrameDecoderListener
classes.description: A test listener that fails on all callback methods, used for testing error handling.

classes.name: LoggingHttp2FrameDecoderListener
classes.description: A decorator listener that logs all callback invocations, optionally wrapping another listener.
